rca_of_issue: Rosary Hail Mary truncation: In a recent change the canonical Hail Mary was expanded in src/prayers/chaplets.ts and partially in src/rosary.ts (lines 130, 131 for Hope/Charity), but the original 'for Faith' opening bead (line 129) and the decade Hail Mary template inside decadeBeads() (line 144) were left with the old '…' truncation. Because decadeBeads is called 5 times per rosary and pushes 10 Hail Marys each, every full rosary contains 50 truncated Hail Marys plus the one 'for Faith' = 51/53 truncated. Backend doesn't store these strings — they are shipped from the frontend bundle and run through the on-device translator. Mitigation: change both string literals to the full canonical text already used in src/prayers/chaplets.ts (e.g. line 166) — single-line copy/paste in two places.
